sources.snippet: Ailey is a persistent, personality-driven AI companion that runs entirely on local hardware (Apple Silicon / MLX). Unlike a stateless chatbot, Ailey has long-term memory, an autonomous "idle thinking" loop, a creative toolset (image / music / video / SVG generation), an email agent, and a self-learning engine — all wired together behind a single backend and exposed through both a web portal ...
